seo.title: Refurbished Commercial Machinery, UAE | YFP Assurance
seo.description: Refurbished commercial kitchen, gym, laundry and CNC woodworking equipment sourced in the UAE, with Skills Mirror condition documentation. UAE, Africa and South Asia buyers.

hero.title: Refurbished Equipment. Documented Performance.
hero.lead: Commercial equipment sourced in the UAE, prepared by refurbishment and technical partners, and supplied by YFP with documentation that shows you what you are buying.

categories.title: Four focused categories.
categories.text: We concentrate on commercial equipment where condition and performance matter most to the buyer, and where documented evidence makes the decision easier.

items.title: Commercial Kitchen Equipment
items.text: Ovens, mixers, cooking equipment, fryers and bakery machinery.

items.title: Commercial Gym Equipment
items.text: Strength machines, cardio equipment, treadmills and fitness systems.

items.title: Commercial Laundry Equipment
items.text: Industrial washing machines, dryers and ironing equipment.

items.title: CNC & Woodworking Machinery
items.text: CNC routers, panel saws, edge banders and workshop equipment.

sourcing.title: Located in the UAE. Prepared by specialists. Sold by YFP.
sourcing.text:
YFP sources machines from suppliers across the UAE and works with refurbishment and technical partners to service, repair and prepare equipment where needed. You receive one quotation and deal only with YFP.

We supply buyers in the UAE and in eligible international markets, particularly across Africa and South Asia. Export eligibility, shipping and import requirements are confirmed for each order before quotation.

steps.title: Share your requirement
steps.text: Category, specification, quantity, destination and budget.

steps.title: We locate suitable equipment
steps.text: Through UAE suppliers and our refurbishment partners.

steps.title: Documentation where applicable
steps.text: Condition, history and recorded testing via Skills Mirror.

steps.title: Quotation & delivery
steps.text: A written quotation from YFP, then coordinated delivery or export.

documentation.title: See the machine before you commit.
documentation.intro: Where applicable, equipment can be accompanied by Skills Mirror documentation covering:
documentation.notice_title: What documentation means, and what it does not.
documentation.notice_text: Documentation records what was observed and tested at the time of recording. It is not a certification, and not every item is fully inspected. Warranty or after-sales support applies only where it is expressly stated in your written quotation. The scope of documentation for each machine is confirmed before you buy.

available.title: Machines currently offered by YFP.
available.text: A selection of equipment YFP is currently offering. Availability changes quickly. Enquire to confirm status, documentation and delivery to your country.

no_stock_notice.title: Looking for available stock?
no_stock_notice.text: We do not run a public listings marketplace. Tell us what you need and we will source it for you.

form.title: Request Equipment Quote
form.intro: The more detail you share, the more accurate our sourcing and quotation.
next_steps: We review your specification and destination.
We confirm availability and the documentation that can be provided.
You receive a written quotation from YFP Assurance.
